classes.CSheetSink:
Option Explicit
Public WithEvents Ws As Worksheet
Public Log As String
Private Sub Ws_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    Log = Log & "chg:" & Target.Address & ";"
End Sub
Private Sub Ws_SelectionChange(ByVal Target As Range)
    Log = Log & "sel:" & Target.Address & ";"
End Sub
Private Sub Ws_Calculate()
    Log = Log & "calc;"
End Sub
Private Sub Ws_Activate()
    Log = Log & "act;"
End Sub
Private Sub Ws_Deactivate()
    Log = Log & "deact;"
End Sub
classes.CBookSink:
Option Explicit
Public WithEvents Wb As Workbook
Public Log As String
Private Sub Wb_SheetChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
    Log = Log & "sheetchg:" & Target.Address & ";"
End Sub
Private Sub Wb_NewSheet(ByVal Sh As Object)
    Log = Log & "new:" & TypeName(Sh) & ";"
End Sub
Private Sub Wb_SheetActivate(ByVal Sh As Object)
    Log = Log & "sheetact;"
End Sub
classes.CAppSink:
Option Explicit
Public WithEvents App As Application
Public Log As String
Private Sub App_SheetChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
    Log = Log & "appchg:" & Target.Address & ";"
End Sub
Private Sub App_WorkbookNewSheet(ByVal Wb As Workbook, ByVal Sh As Object)
    Log = Log & "appnew;"
End Sub
classes.CReentry:
Option Explicit
Public WithEvents Ws As Worksheet
Public Count As Long
Private Sub Ws_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    Count = Count + 1
    If Count < 5 Then Target.Offset(1, 0).Value = Count
End Sub

probes.name: change_single
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Application.EnableEvents = True
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
Dim s As New CSheetSink
Set s.Ws = ws
ws.Range("B2").Value = 1
Probe = s.Log
Application.EnableEvents = False
End Function

probes.name: reentry
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Application.EnableEvents = True
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add

Set r.Ws = ws
ws.Range("A1").Value = 0
Probe = r.Count & "|" & ws.Range("A5").Value & "|" & ws.Range("A6").Value
Application.EnableEvents = False
End Function
